BiblicalUsage: Meshelemiah is a Korahite porter, a gatekeeper of the tabernacle, and the father of porters. 1 Chronicles 26:1 names Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph, and 1 Chronicles 26:2 lists his sons, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third. 1 Chronicles 9:21 says Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gatekeepers are the quiet faithful: a father and his sons, keeping the door so worship could go on inside.
